parole.significato: Used with a stem to create a (usually abstract) noun relating to it; can be compared to -ship, -hood, -ness, -ity, etc.
Used to form nouns relating to some action; -ure, -ing
to rescind, to repeal, to annul
shrubs or trees of the genus Acacia
to appear, show up, turn up, emerge
to prepare a weapon for firing
blessing (some kind of divine or supernatural aid, or reward)
column (cylindrical part of a structure used for support), pillar
consequence (that which follows something on which it depends)
to infer, deduce (to conclude by reasoning or deduction, as from premises or evidence)
fallacious (characterized by fallacy; false or mistaken)
to frequent, to go to (a place)
habit (an action done on a regular basis)
halieutic (of or relating to fishing or fisheries)
to induce, incite, cause or push to do something
to set fire to, to set on fire
to cloud, to obscure (one's view or memory)
unofficial, but which supports the point of view of a government, party, etc.
parsimony (great reluctance to spend money unnecessarily)
silique, a long dry fruit (seed capsule)
the lowest part of something; bottom, ground, base, foundation, bed
rich in wine, full of wine; vinous, winy
